summary: Complete the cloud.terraform integration by creating a job template under Automation Execution > Templates with your Terraform EE and credential, then launching it. Verify in Terraform under Workspaces > Ansible-Content-Integration > Run, where the 'Triggered via CLI' run goes from Queued to Plan Finished.
questions: How do I launch a Terraform job template in AAP?
How do I verify a cloud.terraform job ran in HCP Terraform?
Which EE and credential should a Terraform job template use?
